prompt: Create an issue to fix a bug where the task status filter on the StudyBuddy+ dashboard shows incorrect results — selecting 'in-progress' still displays tasks marked as 'done'.
assertions: The draft H1 title starts with 'Fix'
The draft contains a '## User Story' section with 'As a', 'I want', and 'so that'
The draft contains a '## Acceptance Criteria' section with at least 3 checkbox items (- [ ])
The draft contains a '## Technical Notes' section with Frontend changes, Backend changes, Database, and Dependencies rows
The draft contains a '## Testing Considerations' section (not '## Testing') mentioning edge cases
The H1 title is 60 characters or fewer
The draft file is saved under the issues/ directory (not just the workspace outputs dir)
